The '''Enet system''' was an isolated [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]], located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Brak Sector Force]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] began building a secret base in the system to use as a rendezvous point in case any of their other facilities in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] were discovered.
